name: Restaurant Menu
description: Restaurante completo: menú por secciones con modificadores (tamaños/extras), alérgenos e i18n es/en, horarios de apertura, pedidos en línea y en mesa por código QR, reservas, pago en línea con Stripe, cocina en vivo e informes con CSV. Entrega por WhatsApp incluida.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read menu sections, dishes, modifiers, tables, reservations and incoming orders.
Create/update menu, modifiers, tables and reservations; store orders and their payment state; keep the write-only Stripe key in the plugin's own settings table.
Read the restaurant configuration (currency, ordering toggle, WhatsApp number, opening hours, delivery fee, labels, reservation and payment toggles).
Save the restaurant configuration from the admin page.
Public menu/config/order/reservation/payment endpoints and the admin CRUD, kitchen and reports endpoints.
Add the Restaurante entry to the admin sidebar.
Notify the restaurant about new orders and reservations, and send reservation confirmations to customers (optional, degrades gracefully).
Call the Stripe API (api.stripe.com) to create and verify Checkout Sessions when online payment is enabled.
Zero-PII SSE broadcasts so the live kitchen board updates in real time when orders arrive or change.
